name: Grand Hierophant Khatep
canonNotes: The oldest Liche Priest, Grand Hierophant of Khemri's Mortuary Cult, who awoke Settra after Nagash's Great Ritual.
Ancient and hunched, he bears Settra's anger and the burden of restoring Nehekhara.
voiceNotes: Weary, learned and cautious; speaks in rites and old wisdom.
Deferential to Settra; wary of necromancy.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
